methodology: Each named Wikimedia Commons file description and its linked actual image preview was inspected. Exact identity supported by caption and Commons category/Wikidata; no generated 600x720 file or five-stage reveal inspected, and no final face-identity certification made. Do not copy rights tags onto existing unrelated photos.

decisions.name: 吳建豪
decisions.currentSourceRights: Copyright retained by original source; no open licence asserted
decisions.sourceCaption: Adidas Run For 2008 Olympics in Taiwan: Vanness Wu
decisions.author: Rico Shen (BrockF5)
decisions.sourceLicenseBasis: Self-published by photographer Rico Shen under CC BY-SA 3.0; modifications including crop allowed with attribution and share-alike.
decisions.visualScreening: One clearly identifiable close-up with open unobstructed eyes, visible nose, mouth and chin; microphones are below face. 2008 long hairstyle and facial hair differ from recent public image. Image is portrait-oriented and has adequate source pixels. This is not a final five-stage crop assessment.
decisions.nextAction: Use exact Commons original, not existing copyright-retained file. Download in GitHub Actions with retry/backoff; create fresh uniquely named 600x720 JPEG. Human inspect eyes/nose/mouth/chin/full without background faces or microphones, verify recognizability despite 2008 look; preserve author/source/license/change and share-alike attribution. Only then replace same asset references in BOTH banks and QA.

safeguards: This review concerns proposed replacements only, not rights approval for existing copyright-retained photos.
No source-only metadata should be promoted to humanReviewed, released or playable without full original-pixel and five-stage inspection.
Preserve existing photos, questions, aliases, hints, creators and main until separately verified and QA passes.
For reused photo path across singer and actors, perform one asset-level visual review but update and verify both entries on approved release.
